name: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Cook shrimp 1-2 minutes per side until pink. Remove and set aside.
Add garlic to the pan and cook 30 seconds.
Add frozen peas and carrots, cook 2 minutes.
Push vegetables to the side. Scramble eggs in the empty space until just set.
Add cold rice and break up any clumps. Stir fry everything together 3-4 minutes.
Return shrimp. Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss well. Garnish with green onions.

substitutions.gluten_free: Use tamari instead of soy sauce.
substitutions.low_carb: Replace rice with cauliflower rice — cook 2 minutes less.
substitutions.vegetarian: Replace shrimp with edamame or extra eggs.

notes: Day-old rice works best — fresh rice gets mushy. Make rice the night before.
